venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Monday 1/5.** Chill but better than expected; many guests nursing cocktails and enjoying their groups, with industry folks and out-of-towners looking to bring D&C culture to their bars. Best sellers: First Time Listener, Year of the Trees, Kingkiller. Door: quieter Monday; early 3 tops and an 8 top, solos filtering in, a 9pm wave of 4 tops filled 2/3 of the house, most left by 10:30 for comedy shows; a 5 and 6 top ended the night well. No no-shows. Kitchen: none. Repairs: one lamp with broken charge port, one ottoman with ripped seam.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Monday 1/5.** Slower night on the books: cold weather, Dry January and people heading back to work. MOD cut the host before the shift and told the team heavier cuts would come, ending with just a bartender and a server. Other alley businesses were extremely slow too; D&C and Amazonia had the most bodies. Team used lulls to connect with guests, held a strong GCA and still beat the daily target. Kitchen: food 8.4% of sales; extremely slow, kitchen cut at 9pm. MOD: Josh.
